extDescription.message: CardMarket tooling for YuGiOh: keyboard navigation in BulkListing, suggested prices, mass-edit safeguards, stock tools. No bot, no automated requests.

keyboardNavHint.message: Up/Down move to the next row without touching the quantity or the language, Shift+Left/Right move across columns (comment / number / price / condition / language). + and - adjust the row's quantity.

conditionKeysEnabled.message: Condition and language shortcuts on rows (n, e, g, l, p, !, f, d)

conditionKeysHint.message: On a grid row, outside the comment field: n = Near Mint, e = Excellent, g = Good, l = Light Played, p = Played (twice in a row = Poor), ! = cycles through the languages (French, English, German, then the rest, back to French), f = ticks or unticks first edition, d = duplicates the row and puts the caret on the quantity of the lower of the two rows. Duplication works as many times as needed, including on an already duplicated row. These keys replace the type-ahead selection of the condition and language dropdowns.

massModGuardsEnabled.message: Add lock checkboxes to the mass-edit panel

massModHint.message: The “don’t touch price / number” boxes are auto-checked after the first mass edit.

stockToolsEnabled.message: Show the Stock tools panel on stock pages

stockToolsHint.message: Local location database (comment format “1-02 - MZMU”: rack “1-02”, then the set) and multi-edit. Multi-edit picks listings by comment and/or by price (<=, >=, ==) and can reprice them with the bulk listing engine. Scans and edits only run on click, with a mandatory preview and delays between requests.

orderTotalsEnabled.message: Show the total value of listed orders next to the order count

orderTotalsHint.message: On Sales/Purchases order lists (Paid, Unpaid…). With several pages, the total only covers the displayed page.

rowCopyFixEnabled.message: Keep the values of the copied row

rowCopyHint.message: CardMarket's "Copy row" button clones the row: text fields keep their value, dropdowns do not. So the language falls back to English and the condition to Near Mint on every copy. We put the source row's values back, and give the copied row its price button again.

autoPriceEnabled.message: Add the price button on filled rows

autoPriceHint.message: The price is computed from the product offers, each normalised to a Near Mint equivalent, so an expensive Played listing cannot pull the price up, and a dumped Played one is never a reference for a card in better shape. Every click triggers one request to the product page.

priceMinQty.message: Cumulated copies needed to trust a price

priceMinSellers.message: Distinct sellers needed to trust a price

priceSoloSellerQty.message: Copies that make a lone seller authoritative

priceOutlierRatio.message: Fraction of the reference below which an offer is ignored

priceMaxUpgradeRanks.message: Condition steps allowed to scale a price up (0 = none)

priceThresholdsHint.message: The price goes just under the cheapest offer. These thresholds only serve to spot dumped cards: an offer worth less than half the market reference is ignored, unless one seller holds a large batch of them.

priceUpgradeHint.message: The condition scale only works downwards: a €10 NM gives a €9 EX. The other way round is wrong — a beaten copy dumped at 2 cents says nothing about the price of a clean one, especially on retro and high-value cards. At 0, offers in a worse condition than yours are discarded and, without a reference, no price is suggested.

apButtonHint.message: Compute the selling price from the product offers.

apResumeHint.message: Starts again at the row where the computation stopped, without redoing the previous ones.

apOpenCheckHint.message: Opens the page that triggered the bot check in a new tab. Clear it there, come back, then hit Resume. Do not reload this page: the grid you filled in would be lost.

apDetail.message: €$1 — under the cheapest offer (€$2 NM-equivalent). Market reference €$3 NM over $4 copies from $5 seller(s).

apSkipped.message: $1 offer(s) ignored: too low to be the market price.

apReason_notEnoughStock.message: too few copies or sellers to establish a reliable market reference.

apReason_noComparableOffer.message: no offer in this language with the same attributes (first edition, signed, altered).

apReason_noBetterCondition.message: no offer in an equal or better condition. Rougher copies are not a reference: price this one by hand.

apWorseIgnored.message: $1 offer(s) in a worse condition discarded: the condition scale never scales a price up.

apChallenge.message: CardMarket is asking for a bot check. Use "Open the bot check", clear it in the new tab, then run the computation again. Do not reload this page: the grid you filled in would be lost.

apChallengeStop.message: Stopped on a bot check at "$3": $1 prices written over $2 rows. Open the bot check, clear it, then hit Resume. Do not reload this page: the grid you filled in would be lost.

apCapped.message: Capped by a €$1 listing in equal or better condition.

debug.message: Enable debug logs in the console

stDbEmpty.message: No local data yet. Run a scan.

stEditPageHint.message: Edit only the listings currently displayed.

stPageScope.message: Locked scope: listings visible on this page only.

stPageRows.message: $1 listing(s) read from the displayed page.

stConfirmApplyPage.message: Apply $1 change(s) to this page's listings only?

stAutoHintPage.message: Prices are recomputed only for the listings displayed on this page.

stNeedPriceValue.message: Enter the price to compare against.

stNoPriceRead.message: $1 listing(s) with an unreadable price, left out by the price filter.

stAutoHint.message: The price is recomputed for each listing from the product's offers, using the bulk listing settings. One request per listing (cache aside): start with a single expansion.

stAutoNoAttrs.message: condition or language unreadable on the row

stAutoNoPriceCount.message: $1 listing(s) with no computable price, left untouched.

stAutoUnchanged.message: $1 listing(s) already at the right price.

stInspecting.message: Reading the edit form of article $1…

stInspectDone.message: $1 field(s). The property to change must appear in this list, and its value shows the expected format.

stNoRowHere.message: No listing on this page: open a stock page that lists some.

stPreviewCount.message: $1 article(s) targeted. Check the preview, then Apply.

stPreviewTruncated.message: Preview limited to the first 200 ($1 total).

stNeedSearch.message: Enter the text to search for.

stNotKept.message: the site did not keep the value — sent “$1”, read back “$2”. Nothing else will be changed.

stVerifiedOnce.message: Write confirmed by read-back: carrying on.

stChallenge.message: CardMarket bot check. Open a page of the site, clear the check, then run this again.

stScanEmpty.message: $1: no row read, previous data kept.
